_comment: C# pair: Hot Chocolate+plain EF vs Foundgine+Foundgine EF migrations. Run from tools/foundgine-perf. Gate order: schemaparity, armauthz, then run. Not yet runnable: arm projects not built.

environment.note: Record host details and equal service cpusets; Redis is shared by the four arms and included in each arm resource sample.

cs-baseline.schema_cmd: docker compose -f compose/keycloak.yml -f compose/supplychain.yml exec -T postgres psql -U benchmark -d sc_cs_baseline -At < scenarios/schema_dump.sql
cs-baseline.reset_cmd: docker compose -f compose/keycloak.yml -f compose/supplychain.yml restart cs-baseline >/dev/null && sleep 8 && docker compose -f compose/keycloak.yml -f compose/supplychain.yml exec -T postgres psql -U benchmark -d sc_cs_baseline -At < seed/reset-csharp.sql >/dev/null

cs-foundgine.schema_cmd: docker compose -f compose/keycloak.yml -f compose/supplychain.yml exec -T postgres psql -U benchmark -d sc_cs_foundgine -At < scenarios/schema_dump.sql
cs-foundgine.reset_cmd: docker compose -f compose/keycloak.yml -f compose/supplychain.yml restart cs-foundgine >/dev/null && sleep 8 && docker compose -f compose/keycloak.yml -f compose/supplychain.yml exec -T postgres psql -U benchmark -d sc_cs_foundgine -At < seed/reset-csharp.sql >/dev/null
